record.question: Zebu Breed of Cattle involved in the development of Karan fries is –
record.explanation: The Karan Fries crossbred was developed from Red Sindhi cows crossed with Holstein Friesian bulls, so the Zebu breed is Red Sindhi as printed in the November 2021 paper.
